meta.description: Transit line definitions with headways, capacities, fares, and provenance. ERL headway band and all modelled line memberships/stop orders verified against official sources on 2026-09-25; segment times and bus/minibus/ferry headways remain real-derived estimates.
meta.provenance_note: See data/PROVENANCE.md (S17-S20, S25-S28, S31). ERL capacity is a LegCo secondary figure; bus capacities are vehicle-type estimates; no capacity field is an operator-published measurement. TD headway GTFS expresses variable frequency bands that a single headway_s value cannot represent, so peak-only bus headways stay null.
meta.excluded_lines_note: GMB_481B removed from runnable lines: endpoint BS_TW was manually confirmed invalid and the official stop sequence was unverified (matches contracts/seed missing_nodes_note). Route 481B itself remains registered per TD ROUTE_GMB row 2003214 (2025-12-25) - see data/network/bus_routes.json.

lines.note: Route 1051 愉翠苑-Central (Macao Ferry), full fare HK$20.8 verified (row 2026-01-14); the HK$16.0 lower bound is an unverified section fare. Boards 大圍轉車站-新翠邨 (859) outbound / 大圍站 (6042) inbound; stops 紅隧轉車站 (219/9015). Headway values are estimates - TD GTFS shows variable frequency bands. Earlier KMB-API sourcing (S11) was unverifiable and is superseded by the TD XML evidence.

lines.source: TD ROUTE_BUS/RSTOP_BUS XML (route/order/fare) + user-provided timetable screenshots (weekday departures) + estimated values
lines.headway_note: A single headway_s value cannot faithfully express the documented service: weekday gaps are direction- and time-dependent (to Fleming Road 06:55-08:10: 20/15/9/12/13/6 min; to Yu Chui Court 17:47-18:27: uniform 8 min). The departures come from user-provided screenshots with no capture date or verifiable official origin shown, so no field is promoted to verified; headway_s stays null and consumers must use the per-trip schedule in data/network/bus_routes.json (982X.schedule_evidence) instead. No off-peak, Saturday, Sunday or public-holiday service evidence exists; nothing beyond the two weekday panels is claimed.
lines.note: Full fare corrected 16.0 -> 20.8 per TD rows 8104/8308/8644 (2026-06-12); the HK$6.0 Tai Wai section fare is an appendix claim, unverified. Variants: 8104/8308 AM 愉翠苑/水泉澳->灣仔(菲林明道) via 西隧 (911), boarding 大圍轉車站 6041/6015; 8644 PM 金鐘站(東)->愉翠苑 via 西隧 (921). The screenshots' two panels match variants 8104/8644 by OD only (no variant ID displayed).

Full fare corrected 19.5 -> 20.8 per TD row 8705 (2025-04-03). Current AM service is 田心村->灣仔(軒尼詩道) (route 8705, via 顯徑邨, 西隧 911); no PM-return row exists for 985B in the 2026-09-11 master data (only route 985, 8697 金鐘站(東)->美田). The modelled BS_ADM_E endpoint therefore approximates the 灣仔 alighting area - modelling gap recorded in PROVENANCE.md, contract stops left unchanged.
Does not cross harbour (route 1336 耀安->尖沙咀東(麼地道), full fare HK$10.2 verified, row 2025-08-11). Boards 大圍轉車站 859 outbound / 6042 inbound. Headway values are estimates (TD GTFS variable bands).

Route 1047/8470 沙田站->華富(中), full fare HK$20.8 verified (row 2026-07-23). Serves 大圍轉車站-新翠邨 (859) outbound and 大圍站 (6042) inbound; stops 紅隧轉車站 9014/9015. HK Island end only reaches 华富/Causeway Bay area, not Admiralty/Central. Headway values are estimates. Partial network only.
